register.title: No free, key-less structured odds feed for snooker
register.what_was_checked: OLBG index + event page (2026-09-02), WST match centre, snooker.org, ESPN site API (no snooker coverage), The Odds API requires a key.
register.finding: OLBG server-rendered pages expose tipster vote counts, never prices. WST/snooker.org publish no price data. No public key-less price feed exists.
register.effect_on_output: The 30-pt Odds Strength component is recorded as missing on every live card; Step 3's price-gated rules (Full Bet / Small Bet / profitability check) resolve to SKIP; written verdicts and confidence are still produced from sourced factors; HIGH is impossible on a live card.

register.title: Amateur replacement in the draw — Mark Joyce replaced Ronnie O'Sullivan
register.what_was_checked: snooker.org British Open pages and player page 48; WST ranking list; BBC results.
register.finding: Joyce is an amateur (last pro season 2023, career-best ranking 29) and entered the British Open as O'Sullivan's replacement. He is NOT on the official WST ranking list. Patrick Whelan likewise replaced Mark Allen.
register.effect_on_output: Joyce's World Ranking component is 0 pts (unranked) and carries the -5 opponent-ranked-higher deduction. Any 'upset' narrative is never invented; the ranking factor simply scores what the official list shows.

register.title: Match start time disagrees across public sources
register.what_was_checked: WST venue match centre (15:00), OLBG event page (17:00), BBC Sport results page (21:00), snooker.org live page (Est. 16:00 America/New_York).
register.finding: No two sources agree; snooker.org labels its time an estimate and renders in America/New_York, so 16:00 ET = 21:00 BST agrees with BBC. WST's 15:00 may be the pre-update schedule.
register.effect_on_output: The slate records display_time per source and start_utc: null. The calendar never infers a start time; collectors must capture the WST match-centre value as the venue reference.

register.title: api.snooker.org and /players/{name} on wst.tv are not usable key-less
register.what_was_checked: api.snooker.org/?t=0&st=1 (HTTP 401.5 access denied from this environment), wst.tv/players/pang-junxu (404), cuetracker.net player/H2H pages (client-rendered shells).
register.finding: The snooker.org REST API requires credentials; WST player pages use UUID routes; CueTracker renders content via JavaScript and serves no static HTML.
register.effect_on_output: Collectors read the public snooker.org HTML pages (results/upcoming/player) and the WST match-centre URLs, with reconstructed-fixture parser tests. CueTracker is referenced for manual review only (IR-SNOOKER-06).

register.title: snooker.org player pages order rows by event/round, not by match date
register.what_was_checked: Player pages 1257 and 48 for the 2026-27 season; cross-checked dates via the British Open results stream and BBC.
register.finding: Rows outside the observed British Open stream carry no per-match date; the tape therefore records event windows and explicit round_index (knock-out round order = chronological order). Two British Open rows carry observed dates (31 Aug / 01 Sep).
register.effect_on_output: Profile ordering is deterministic and leak-free, but precise day-level ordering inside an event window relies on round_index; the collector upgrades date_basis to observed as the stream supplies it.

register.title: CueTracker is a manual-review link only
register.finding: Pages render via JavaScript; static extraction returns shells. Only the snooker.org H2H page renders statically and was used for the verified zero-meeting H2H.
register.effect_on_output: CueTracker appears in source lists for human review; it is never fetched by collectors.

register.title: Pang Junxu v Mark Joyce — zero completed meetings (verified)
register.what_was_checked: snooker.org dedicated H2H page (player1=1257, player2=48, all seasons).
register.finding: The page lists only the upcoming British Open Round 3 fixture — no prior meeting exists.
register.effect_on_output: The 20-pt H2H component is recorded as missing (0 pts) on this fixture rather than guessed as 'roughly even' (substitution S-06). The tape covers only the 2026-27 season, so H2H for other pairings awaits tape growth.

register.title: snooker.org registers results in America/New_York and registration time ≠ start time
register.what_was_checked: British Open results stream headings and times; WST venue schedule.
register.finding: Times on the results stream are registrations in America/New_York (e.g. Pang-Robertson 18:43 NY = 01 Sep UK late session while the venue day was 31 Aug/01 Sep).
register.effect_on_output: The tape uses the registered DAY (cross-checked with WST/BBC) and never derives start times; collectors must not convert registration times into kick-off times.
